integrity: All analytic statements are derived in RESULT.md; finite numerical tests are corroborative, not proofs. Historical priority is provisional.
scientific_limitations: Regular Euclidean simplices, independent uniform-volume sampling, and an asymptotic expansion only. No finite-dimensional monotonicity or universal nonregular-simplex extension is proved. General higher-order Edgeworth machinery is a historical-priority risk; the closely related 2006 correlation article was not accessible in full. Independent audit has not been performed.
title: The second asymptotic correction to centroid spherical depth in regular simplices
